findings.title: Test function name not updated after rename
findings.body: The test function is still named `TestInstrumentationMiddleware` after the file and middleware were renamed to `metrics_middleware.go`/`MetricsMiddleware`. The function name should be renamed to `TestMetricsMiddleware` to match the new naming and avoid confusion for future maintainers.

findings.title: No test for new ContextualLoggerMiddleware
findings.body: The new `ContextualLoggerMiddleware` was extracted from the old `InstrumentationMiddleware` but no corresponding test file was added. The `instrumentContext` helper, which sets the `endpoint`, `pluginId`, `dsName`, `dsUID`, and `uname` attributes on the request context, should be covered by tests to ensure these attributes are correctly set for QueryData, CallResource, CheckHealth, and CollectMetrics, and that they are absent for the streaming methods (SubscribeStream, PublishStream, RunStream) which intentionally pass through.

findings.title: FromContext doc comment does not match implementations
findings.body: The new `FromContext` doc comment says it returns a new contextual Logger that has 'this logger's context plus the given context', but the two implementations in the diff (`grafanaInfraLogWrapper.FromContext` in `pkg/plugins/log/logger.go` and `TestLogger.FromContext` in `pkg/plugins/log/fake.go`) only use the passed-in context and ignore the receiver's state. Either the comment should be corrected to describe the actual behavior (e.g. 'returns a Logger derived from the given context') or the implementations should be updated to also include the receiver's existing context.
